notes.title: Update 2.5 - Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are pleased to announce the latest update for Rhythm Any Music, bringing a host of improvements and fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Check out the new features:

Bug Fixes: We have resolved various bugs reported by the community, ensuring a smoother and uninterrupted gameplay experience.
Note Detection System Enhancements: The note detection and generation system has been significantly improved. The accuracy of notes is now much better, providing a more precise and engaging gameplay experience.
Long Note Detection Improvements: We have adjusted and refined the detection of long notes, correcting any inconsistencies to ensure they are detected and executed correctly during gameplay.
General Tweaks: Small improvements and adjustments have been made to improve overall gameplay and user experience.
We are always listening to feedback from our community and working hard to make Rhythm Any Music the best rhythm game possible. Keep sending us your suggestions and reporting any issues you encounter.

Enjoy and keep on grooving!

notes.title: New gameplay HUD and minor tweaks and improvements
notes.content:
Hello, players!

I'm excited to share with you a new update for Rhythm Any Music! As a solo indie developer, I've been on a break for personal reasons, but now I'm back to work and ready to bring improvements and new features to the game. I appreciate the patience and support from all of you during this time.

With this update, I'm introducing a new Head-Up Display (HUD) to enhance the gameplay experience! The new design is more modern and intuitive, allowing you to quickly and easily access the most important information during your matches. I've listened to your feedback and worked hard to provide a more efficient and enjoyable HUD.

In addition to the new HUD, I've made some small adjustments and improvements in various areas of the game. These changes are focused on enhancing stability, fixing bugs, and ensuring a more balanced and fun gaming experience for all players.

This update is just the beginning! I'm working on new content and improvements that will be released in future updates. Stay tuned for more exciting news, and as always, I would love to hear your feedback.

Thank you again for your understanding and support during my break. I'm very excited to share everything I have planned for the future of the game, and I hope you enjoy this update as much as I do!

See you in the game!
